title: The gap step's weak-lead rule admits off-subject gaps through a qualifier title word, a slug stem or one lacked word in a fact
goal: ql_apply.weak_off_topic rejects a weak gap candidate whose only link to its lead is a qualifier word in the title ('architecture decision records ADR format status superseded' under privacy/nist-sp800-38g, F-f3230e66064f), a stem of the slug ('How long do deleted emails stay in the recycle bin?' under entra/bitlocker-key-deletion) or a single lacked word in one fact ('How long do deleted emails stay recoverable in Exchange Online?' under entra/stale-devices); tests cover each case (found in the SP-4slunkaj review)

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import kbfacts, ql_apply; from ql_learn import domain_article; g=ql_apply.Gate(); r=kbfacts.pack('architecture decision records ADR format status superseded', fmt='concise'); sys.exit(not ql_apply.weak_off_topic(r, domain_article(r, g.article_of), g))
